items.title: After love on TV – Nathalie and Rasmus are expecting a child
items.summary: It is on Instagram that the former letter writer from season twenty of "Farmer seeks wife" reveals that she is pregnant. "A year ago today, we chose each other. And now we are waiting for someone who is half Nathalie and half Rasmus. Words cannot describe how this feels, it is indescribable," the post says. In the comments section, presenter Linda Lindorff writes that she is fainting from happiness. "You two found each other and it was so clear that it was going to be you, it was meant to be. You are perfect for each other and you can see how incredibly happy you are. Now you are becoming a family and a dream has come true," writes the presenter. "Now I want nothing more than to be a mother" Nathalie Basiri tells TV4 Nyheterna that the couple does not yet know the gender of the child and that the name must be decided by who is "hiding in there". However, the dream of becoming a mother has not always been obvious to her. "But it came so naturally and as a matter of course when I met Rasmus. And now I want nothing more than to become a mother and am so happy that it is Rasmus I get to share this with," she writes. The first time the letter writer met Rasmus Helge during the recording, she wrote directly to her best girl friend that she had "found him". "So that probably says a lot. It felt right away that it was right".
items.title_original: Efter kärleken i tv – Nathalie och Rasmus väntar barn
items.summary_original: Det är på Instagram som den tidigare brevskrivaren från säsong tjugo av ”Bonde söker fru” avslöjar att hon är gravid. ”För ett år sedan idag valde vi varandra. Och nu väntar vi på någon som är hälften Nathalie och hälften Rasmus. Ord kan inte beskriva hur detta känns, det är obeskrivligt”, står det i inlägget. I kommentarsfältet skriver programledare Linda Lindorff att hon svimmar av lycka. ”Ni två fann varandra och det var så tydligt att det skulle bli just ni, det var meningen. Ni är perfekta för varandra och man ser hur otroligt lyckliga ni är. Nu blir ni familj och en dröm är uppfylld”, skriver programledaren. ”Nu vill jag inget hellre än att bli mamma” För TV4 Nyheterna berättar Nathalie Basiri att paret ännu inte vet barnets kön och att namnet får avgöras av vem som ”gömmer sig där inne”. Drömmen om att bli mamma har dock inte alltid varit självklar för henne. ”Men det kom så naturligt och som en självklarhet när jag träffade Rasmus. Och nu vill jag inget hellre än att bli mamma och är så glad att det är Rasmus jag får dela detta med”, skriver hon. Första gången brevskrivaren träffade Rasmus Helge under inspelningen skrev hon direkt till sin bästa tjejkompis att hon ”hittat han”. ”Så det säger nog en del. Det kändes direkt att det va rätt”.

items.title: He examines the perfection of hipster life with a clinical eye
items.summary: Berlin in the 2010s was a hotbed for trend-conscious young people. Italian Vincenzo Latronico depicts this hipster culture in the popular novel "Perfection". He captures the zeitgeist perfectly, writes Rebecka Kärde.

items.title: The policy rate remains unchanged at 1.75 percent
items.summary: Inflation in Sweden is low and the economic situation is somewhat weaker than normal. At the same time, the supply disruptions linked to the war in the Middle East have led to increased inflationary pressure and the risks of inflation becoming too high have increased. The management assesses that it is well balanced to now leave the key interest rate unchanged at 1.75 percent, but the probability that the interest rate will be raised later this year has increased compared to the assessment in March.
items.summary_original: Inflationen i Sverige är låg och konjunkturläget är något svagare än normalt. Samtidigt har utbudsstörningarna kopplade till kriget i Mellanöstern lett till att inflationstrycket stigit och riskerna för att inflationen ska bli för hög har ökat. Direktionen bedömer att det är välavvägt att nu lämna styrräntan oförändrad på 1,75 procent, men sannolikheten för att räntan höjs senare i år har ökat jämfört med bedömningen i mars.

items.title: Government receives new state aid application for nuclear power
items.summary: A new application for state aid to build nuclear power reactors has been submitted to the Government. This is the third application for state aid received by the Government.

items.title: Inauguration of Ukraine’s Unity Hub in Sweden
items.summary: On 15 June, a hub for Ukrainians in Sweden is being inaugurated. The Hub is a new meeting place that will provide support, guidance and information to Ukrainians in Sweden. Minister for Migration Johan Forssell will attend the inauguration together with Deputy Minister of Social Policy, Family and Unity of Ukraine for European Integration Ilona Havronska and representatives of the International Centre for Migration Policy Development (ICMPD), Swedish government agencies, civil society and the Ukrainian diaspora.

items.title: New support package for democratic development in Eastern Europe
items.summary: The Government has presented a new support package with a focus on democracy and strengthened civil society in Eastern Europe for SEK 30 million for 2026–2028, of which SEK 17 million is earmarked for 2026. The support includes well-established civil society organisations in Europe, with which Sweden has had excellent cooperation over a long time.

items.title: Sweden provides SEK 120 million to WHO with focus on Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.summary: Sweden is providing SEK 120 million to support the World Health Organization’s work to achieve better global health, which is of great importance to global health security and people in crisis-affected areas. The WHO’s role is of vital importance and central to how the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is handled.

items.title: Joint statement on 10 June 2026
items.summary: Albania, Australia, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, France, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Netherlands, New Zealand, North Macedonia, Norway, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, and the United States of America condemn the lethal plotting and other malign actions in Europe, North America and Australia by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-Intelligence Organisation, Quds Force and Ministry of Intelligence and Security, including those against Iranian dissidents, journalists and Jewish and Israeli communities and interests. We stand united in our determination to protect our countries and our people against these threats. The Islamic Republic of Iran must halt these actions now.

The democracy support totals SEK 13.35 million and will go to local elections observation and greater integrity of elections and resilience against disinformation in Armenia and Moldova.

items.title: The Riksbank's business survey: "A new black swan" that risks delaying the recovery
items.summary: According to the large Swedish companies, the economic situation is still weak. Before the war in the Middle East broke out, it was felt that the economy was cautiously improving. The war does not seem to have significantly affected that image. But uncertainty has increased again, which the companies believe risks delaying the already protracted recovery.
items.title_original: Riksbankens företagsundersökning:  ”En ny svart svan” som riskerar att fördröja återhämtningen
items.summary_original: Enligt de svenska storföretagen är konjunkturläget fortfarande svagt. Innan kriget i Mellanöstern bröt ut upplevde man att konjunkturen försiktigt förbättrades. Kriget tycks inte nämnvärt ha påverkat den bilden. Men osäkerheten har ökat igen, vilket företagen menar riskerar att försena den redan utdragna återhämtningen.

items.title: New inquiry appointed to facilitate divestment of property holdings that threaten national security
items.summary: To mitigate security threats posed by certain property holdings, an inquiry has been appointed to propose changes to the Expropriation Act, i.e. the legislation under which a property owner may be compelled to transfer their property holding. The purpose is to ensure that Sweden’s Government can act when a property is at risk of being used in a way that threatens national security.

items.title: Maria Malmer Stenergard met with Ukrainian Minister of Foreign Affairs Andrii Sybiha in Kristianstad
items.summary: On Wednesday 20 May, Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard travelled to Kristianstad along with Ukrainian Minister of Foreign Affairs Andrii Sybiha for a bilateral meeting, a walkabout and a ceremony. Mr Sybiha then undertook other visits in southern Sweden before attending the meeting of NATO Ministers of Foreign Affairs in Helsingborg.
